# Configuration reference

*Generated by `scripts/gen_config_docs.py` from `bratsgan/config.py`; do not edit by hand.*

Every experiment is a JSON file in `configs/` that overrides a subset of these defaults. Individual keys can be overridden on the command line with `--set key=value` (values are parsed as JSON), for example:

```bash
python -m bratsgan.train --config configs/a5_full.json --set name=demo epochs_seg=10 patch=[64,64,64]
```

## General

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `exp` | Run name; the output goes to `<out_dir>/<name>/`. |
| `cache_dir` | `cache` | Directory with the pre-processed cases written by `prepare_data.py`. |
| `splits` | `splits.json` | JSON file with the patient-level test set and cross-validation folds. |
| `fold` | `0` | Cross-validation fold used for validation (the others are used for training). |
| `out_dir` | `runs` | Parent directory of the run directories. |
| `seed` | `42` | Random seed (model initialisation, patch sampling, augmentation). |
| `amp` | `True` | Automatic mixed precision (only used on CUDA). |
| `deterministic` | `False` | Request deterministic PyTorch kernels (slower). |
| `device` | `auto` | `auto` selects CUDA when available, otherwise CPU; or an explicit device string. |

## Architecture

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_ch` | `4` | Number of input channels (four MR sequences). |
| `out_ch` | `3` | Number of output channels (the nested regions WT, TC, ET). |
| `base` | `32` | Number of feature channels at the first resolution level. |
| `depth` | `5` | Number of resolution levels of the encoder. |
| `max_ch` | `320` | Upper bound for the number of channels at any level. |
| `residual` | `True` | Use residual blocks instead of plain double convolutions. |
| `attention` | `True` | Use additive attention gates on the skip connections. |
| `fusion` | `maf` | Input stem: `early` (channel concatenation) or `maf` (modality-attentive fusion). |
| `norm` | `instance` | Normalisation layer: `instance`, `group` or `batch`. |
| `deep_supervision` | `True` | Add auxiliary outputs at the three coarsest decoder levels. |
| `dropout` | `0.0` | Probability of the channel dropout (`Dropout3d`) in the network; 0 disables it. |

## Data and schedule

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `patch` | `[128, 128, 128]` | Training patch size (D, H, W). |
| `batch_size` | `2` | Patches per optimisation step. |
| `iters_per_epoch` | `250` | Optimisation steps per epoch. |
| `epochs_seg` | `300` | Epochs of the segmentation stage. |
| `epochs_adv` | `50` | Epochs of the adversarial stage that follows (ignored if `gan` is false). |
| `num_workers` | `4` | Data-loader worker processes. |
| `fg_prob` | `0.67` | Probability that a training patch is centred on a tumour voxel. |

## Optimisation

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lr` | `0.0003` | Initial learning rate of the generator (AdamW). |
| `weight_decay` | `1e-05` | Weight decay of the generator optimiser. |
| `poly_power` | `0.9` | Exponent of the polynomial learning-rate decay. |
| `grad_clip` | `12.0` | Gradient-norm clipping threshold. |

## Segmentation loss

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `w_dice` | `1.0` | Weight of the soft Dice loss. |
| `w_tv` | `1.0` | Weight of the Tversky loss (0 disables it). |
| `w_bce` | `1.0` | Weight of the binary cross-entropy loss. |
| `tv_alpha` | `0.3` | Tversky weight of false positives. |
| `tv_beta` | `0.7` | Tversky weight of false negatives. |
| `tv_gamma` | `1.0` | Exponent of the focal Tversky loss (1 = plain Tversky, below 1 = focal). |

## Adversarial refinement

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gan` | `True` | Enable the adversarial stage. |
| `ndf` | `32` | Base channel count of the PatchGAN discriminator. |
| `d_lr` | `0.0002` | Learning rate of the discriminator. |
| `d_betas` | `[0.5, 0.999]` | Adam betas of the discriminator. |
| `adv_weight` | `0.05` | Weight lambda of the adversarial term in the generator loss. |
| `adv_ramp_epochs` | `5` | Epochs over which the adversarial weight is ramped up linearly. |
| `d_steps` | `1` | Discriminator steps per generator step. |
| `adv_loss` | `lsgan` | `lsgan` or `hinge`. |
| `real_smooth` | `0.05` | One-sided label smoothing for real samples. |
| `d_noise` | `0.05` | Standard deviation of the instance noise added to the discriminator inputs. |

## Evaluation

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `val_every` | `5` | Validate every this many epochs. |
| `val_overlap` | `0.5` | Window overlap during validation. |
| `final_overlap` | `0.5` | Window overlap for the final evaluation. |
| `final_tta` | `False` | Mirror test-time augmentation in the final evaluation. |
| `hierarchy` | `True` | Project predictions onto the nesting ET in TC in WT. |
